geometry.domain: one quadrant of one drop: axis r=0, symmetry plane z=0, free surface S(t)

mesh.remesh_rule: remesh whenever R_min has grown by a factor of 4 (Anthony 2020, Sec. II.B.2)
mesh.bridge_region: ellipse of Eq. 6: z1=R_min (R_min<1/2), r2=2*R_min, slope tan(pi/3) at axis, 0 at plane; lagged one step

output.cadence_unit: decades of R_min (log10) between diagnostic records; states also written at every remesh
output.cadence_rule: every remesh and every decade of R_min

completion.note: stop when the bridge reaches half the drop radius, or on reconnection (Duchemin et al. 2003), which the ALE algorithm cannot continue past

provenance.note: Default case: two equal drops coalescing at Oh = 0.6 from the approximate point-contact bridge R0 = 1e-3, Z0 = R0^2/2. Copy it and change physics.Oh (or set physics.inertia to false for Stokes) and physics.initial_bridge for other cases.
